content:
9to5Mac Daily is a news podcast that covers the latest headlines from 9to5Mac, hosted by Chance Miller. Published every weekday, it delivers quick updates on Apple news, rumors, and reviews. Listen on iTunes, Apple Podcasts, Stitcher, TuneIn, Google Play, or through RSS for overcast and other podcast players.

Sponsored by Stuff: Stuff is a simple and elegant task management app that helps you organize everything in your head. Clear your backlog, reduce mental clutter, and stay on top of your to-dos across iPhone, iPad, and Mac. Get Stuff done today.

New episodes of 9to5Mac Daily are recorded on weekdays. Subscribe on Apple Podcasts or your favorite podcast app to be notified as soon as a new episode drops.

Stories covered in this episode:

  • Following Trump's order, Apple Maps renames 'Lake Ontario' to 'Lake of the Americas'
  • Apple's executive shakeup continues as Terry Ternus takes the CEO role
  • How much will incoming CEO John Ternus and executive chairman Tim Cook earn? We'll break it down
  • The full text of the internal memo that John Ternus sent to Apple employees on his first day as CEO
